text:
Nina (partnerships): Quick sync — LangChain engineering asked if we can support orchestrator-level callbacks + gateway auth for their marketplace bundle. They want a single SKU that wires LlamaIndex connectors -> our gateway.
Omar (eng-ml): Are they expecting managed connectors or just a reference adapter? Important for SLA and billing.
Ken (marketplace): SKU should reflect managed vs self-hosted. If managed, we need usage meters and support tier. Suggest two SKUs: sandbox (free) and managed (paid).
Sofia (devex): For the reference adapter we need a sample repo, CI checks, and a smoke harness. I can fork the sandbox adapter and add GitHub Actions to run smoke tests against staging.
Yuki (security): Security checklist: token exchange flow, minimum TLS ciphers, and review of webhook endpoints. Also need a data retention note for the marketplace listing.
Nina (partnerships): LangChain also asked about cert badge "Redwood-Verified Gateway" if we pass integration tests. Can we define pass criteria?
Omar (eng-ml): Proposal for cert tests: 1) auth handshake (OIDC or API key), 2) data-model roundtrip (embedding + retrieve), 3) KV cache compatibility, 4) graceful fallback when model unavailable. All automated in CI.
Sofia (devex): I'll sketch a GH Actions matrix: node/python adapters x auth modes x small/large payloads. Smoke command example:
```
# run smoke against staging gateway
export TOKEN=staging-token
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"query":"who wrote the redwood manifesto?","use_cache":true}' \
  https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/gateway/adapter/run | jq .
```
Ken (marketplace): Timing: LangChain wants co-announcement the week of Jun 7. To make that, listing + cert must be done by May 28. Ops will need 48h to propagate SKUs.
Yuki (security): I need the integration design doc by May 12 to do threat modeling. Include scopes for token exchange and replay protection.
Omar (eng-ml): One more thing — orchestration tools expect streaming + tool-calling hooks. We should expose the event hook spec in the adapter. I'll draft a minimal spec doc.
Nina (partnerships): Action items: Sofia -> sample repo + CI template (due May 10), Omar -> event hook spec + cert test harness (due May 12), Yuki -> security review schedule (due May 12), Ken -> SKU proposal & pricing bands (due May 14). I'll coordinate partner comms and schedule a tech call Fri 10am PT.
deploy-bot: deploy: staging-adapter-runner v1.3.2 rolled out to cs-integ-01 :rocket: (build 987)
Sofia (devex): Added initial repo: https://github.com/redwood/integration-samples/tree/langchain-gateway (draft branch). CI runs now on pushes.
Omar (eng-ml): Drafted event hook spec gdoc: https://docs.google.com/fake-link/event-hooks (comments open). Covers stream frames, tool call envelope, and retry semantics.
Ken (marketplace): Noted timeline. Also looping in billing to confirm metering of tokens vs request units.
Yuki (security): Will run a quick threat model Wed; ping me in calendar invite.
Nina (partnerships): Great progress. Please add any blocker comments in the doc before Thu EOD so we can present a unified plan on Friday. Thanks!
